page.title: Rules
page.subtitle: Fill in tags, categories and payees automatically when a transaction is created or imported

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.body: A rule watches new and imported transactions and fills in tags, categories or payees when its conditions match. Create your first rule to get started.

error.title: Your rules could not be loaded
error.body: Nothing is shown because the request failed, not because you have no rules. Check your connection and try again.

list.summary: {trigger, select, create {When created} import {When imported} both {When created or imported} other {No trigger}} · {conditions, plural, =0 {No conditions} one {# condition} other {# conditions}} · {actions, plural, =0 {No actions} one {# action} other {# actions}}

reasons.referenceMissing: a tag, payee, category or account it uses no longer exists
reasons.duplicateAction: it repeats an action that is allowed only once
reasons.unreadable: its saved definition cannot be read

delete.title: Delete rule
delete.message: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.

toasts.duplicated: Rule duplicated. The copy is switched off until you enable it
toasts.reorderFailed: Failed to change the order of the rules
toasts.listChanged: The list of rules changed elsewhere and has been reloaded. Try again
